CreateAccount.docs: An account was created (internal, sent to that account only)

CreateSession.docs: A session was created for this account

DeleteSession.docs: A session of this account was deleted

DeleteAllSessions.docs: All sessions of this account were deleted

VoiceChannelMove.docs: Someone was moved to another voice channel

UserVoiceStateUpdate.docs: Someone muted, deafened, started video or screen sharing

UserMoveVoiceChannel.docs: You are asked to move to another voice channel

VoiceCallUpdate.docs: A call in a DM or group started or ended

UserPlatformWipe.docs: A user was removed from the platform; drop their messages, DMs and memberships from your cache

Bulk.docs: Several events in one packet (field v); handle each one

Ready.docs: First event after Authenticate: the users, servers, channels, members and emojis the bot can see

Authenticated.docs: The token was accepted; Ready follows

MessagePollChoice.docs: Your own choice on a poll changed (people only: bots cannot vote)
